summary: Fresh mobile web load, authenticated navigation, settings persistence, logout attempts, and backend auth/profile/preferences/logout contracts were tested. Backend regression tests passed 2/2. UI loaded and login worked, but several required controls lack stable selectors/accessibility labels, preventing reliable end-to-end automation of settings/chat/logout.

ui_bugs.issue: Email, password, login, signup, and Google controls have no testID, so localized UI requires brittle placeholder/text selectors.
Profile settings button has no testID or accessibilityLabel; role-based automation could not identify it reliably.
Quick action tiles and theme/settings header controls lack testIDs, leaving scanner and settings entry points difficult to automate.
Composer and send button lack testIDs; chat integration could not be reliably exercised after navigation drift.

action_items: Add stable testIDs to all auth inputs/buttons, profile settings, home actions/header controls, scanner picker/analyze, chat composer/send, and profile fields/save/logout.
Use EXPO_BACKEND_URL consistently in frontend API configuration or document the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL alias explicitly.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/lib/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/Expo extra backendUrl rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL key; current preview works only because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is configured.
Google login button has no error UI around googleLogin(), so rejected/failed OAuth may be silent.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing QA account and restored Hindi/light preferences.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The QA account starts at Hindi/light. Fresh load can restore the authenticated session. Profile navigation appeared visually but was not reliably targeted by role selectors; add selectors before rerunning complete UI coverage.
rca_of_issue: The app relies on localized visible text for many interactive controls and only recently added selectors to Settings and bottom tabs. Missing testIDs/accessibility labels cause automation failures independent of backend behavior; backend CRUD/auth invalidation and ObjectId-safe response checks passed.
